verdict.rationale: YPOG is a law, tax and notary firm. Its offerings are advisory services on transactions, funds, ESOPs and IP/data protection, not a software product with telemetry, so a telemetry opt-out story is a category error for this kind of product. The firm's mention of legal tech and its software-supported YSolutions unit does not show any shipped telemetry or tracking controls, so the axis does not become applicable.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
